_comment: FIXED BEFORE ANY RESULTS WERE SEEN. Adding a case after seeing an outcome is how a benchmark becomes an advert — append with a dated note saying why, never edit one to fit a result.

cases.kind: multi-hop TS flow in a 10k-file monorepo
cases.task: How does a booking get created end to end — which modules participate, and where does it hit the database?
cases.ground_truth: LSP/tsc-assisted for the call edges; DB writes verified against the prisma schema
cases.why: grep's home ground (one language) but multi-hop, so the agent LOOP cost is what is really being measured.

cases.task: How does the admin UI read and update a realm — trace it from the TypeScript admin client to the Java server side.
cases.ground_truth: partial and DECLARED as partial: the Java side is verifiable, the TS-to-Java hop is by REST route and is exactly what neither tool can resolve by symbol
cases.why: Where a symbol graph goes dark. Also the case where a HONEST blindspot is worth more than a confident wrong answer.
